policy_name: Aarambh Bank Illustrative Personal Loan Demo Policy
authority: Fictional bank policy for a synthetic presales demonstration; not a real bank policy.

clauses.title: Age and maturity
clauses.text: Applicants must be 21 to 58 years old at application, and the loan must mature no later than the applicant's 60th birthday.

clauses.title: Minimum net income
clauses.text: The applicant's verified net monthly income must be at least Rs 25,000.

clauses.title: Employment experience
clauses.text: Applicants need at least 6 months with their current employer and 12 months of total work experience.

clauses.title: Amount limits
clauses.text: The requested amount must be Rs 50,000 to Rs 15,00,000 and cannot exceed 15 times verified net monthly income.

clauses.title: Tenure limits
clauses.text: The requested loan tenure must be between 12 and 60 months.

clauses.title: Fixed-obligation-to-income ratio
clauses.text: FOIR up to 45% passes this check; above 45% through 50% is referred for review; above 50% is declined.

clauses.title: Bureau score bands
clauses.text: A score of 750 or more is low-risk pass; 700 to 749 is medium-risk pass; 650 to 699 is referred; below 650 is declined.

clauses.title: Severe delinquency
clauses.text: Any payment more than 90 days past due during the previous 24 months fails this check.

clauses.title: Recent credit enquiries
clauses.text: No more than 5 bureau enquiries may have occurred in the previous 6 months.

clauses.title: Thin bureau file
clauses.text: An applicant without bureau history is referred, and the eligible amount is capped at Rs 75,000.

clauses.title: Identity checks
clauses.text: Verified KYC with a name match of at least 0.85 passes; pending or a lower name match is referred for completion or manual review; an invalid or missing PAN is declined.

clauses.title: Income-document consistency
clauses.text: Bank salary credits must be within 10% of payslip net income; payslip gross less deductions must reconcile to net; and employer names must match.

clauses.title: Illustrative pricing
clauses.text: Annual reducing-balance rates are 11.5% for scores 750+, 13.5% for scores 700-749, and 16% for scores 650-699.

clauses.title: Human sanction approval
clauses.text: Every sanction requires an affirmative human approval; AI does not sanction loans.

clauses.title: Reason for an override
clauses.text: A human decision that differs from the AI recommendation must include a written reason.

regulatory_topic_notes.title: Digital lending disclosures
regulatory_topic_notes.text: A digital loan journey should clearly present material costs and terms, including a Key Fact Statement, and explain any applicable cooling-off option. Summary for demo; verify against the official RBI document

regulatory_topic_notes.title: Fair practices
regulatory_topic_notes.text: Customer communications and servicing should be transparent, respectful, and consistent, with clear routes to raise and resolve concerns. Summary for demo; verify against the official RBI document

regulatory_topic_notes.title: Credit-bureau reporting
regulatory_topic_notes.text: Credit information should be handled and reported through appropriate authorized processes, with care for accuracy and customer dispute handling. Summary for demo; verify against the official RBI document
